claims: WrestleMania 42 is scheduled as a two-night event on Saturday, April 18, and Sunday, April 19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 is scheduled at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, Nevada.
WrestleMania 42 marks a consecutive-year return to Las Vegas.
CM Punk vs. Roman Reigns is a confirmed match at WrestleMania 42.
Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton is a confirmed match at WrestleMania 42.
CM Punk vs. Roman Reigns is scheduled for the World Heavyweight Championship at WrestleMania 42.
Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton is scheduled for the Undisputed WWE Championship at WrestleMania 42.
Rhea Ripley vs. Jade Cargill is scheduled for the WWE Women’s Championship at WrestleMania 42.
Liv Morgan vs. Stephanie Vaquer is scheduled for the Women's World Championship at WrestleMania 42.
Brock Lesnar vs. Oba Femi is a match at WrestleMania 42.
AJ Lee vs. Becky Lynch is a match at WrestleMania 42.
Two-day combo tickets for WrestleMania 42 are available via Ticketmaster and On Location.
Priority Pass packages for WrestleMania 42 are available via Ticketmaster and On Location.
